keywords.ko: 무슨 이유에서 인 지 스마트폰이 연결이 계속 끊겨. 최근에 더 심해졌어.
kepp ing + lose connection을 사용하는 게 더나음 (수동태형태로 사용하려면  being disconnected라고 복잡해지니까)

keywords.ko: 너가 스마트폰을 바꿀 때가 된 건지도 모르겠다.

keywords.en: A: My phone keeps losing connection for some reason.
keywords.ko: 여기서 time은 시간보다는 시기적인 상황이 더맞음

keywords.en: B: Have you tried restarting it?
A: You mean turning it off and on? Yeah of course.
Sometimes it works. Sometimes it doesn’t

my_sentences.en: 1. keep + -ing

my_sentences.ko: → keep + -ing는 같은 일이 반복될 때 사용해.
특히 “자꾸 ~해”, “계속 ~해”라는 불편함을 말할 때 정말 자연스러워.

my_sentences.en: My computer keeps freezing.
My Wi-Fi keeps disconnecting.
He keeps forgetting my name.
This app keeps crashing.
2.for some reason

my_sentences.ko: → 정확한 이유는 모르지만 어떤 이유가 있는 것 같다는 느낌.

my_sentences.en: For some reason, I can't log in.
She seems upset for some reason.
my_sentences.ko: 왜인지 그녀가 기분이 안 좋아 보여.

my_sentences.en: For some reason, this doesn't work.
He keeps calling me for some reason.
It has gotten worse lately.

my_sentences.ko: → get worse = 더 나빠지다 / 더 심해지다

my_sentences.en: My headaches have gotten worse lately.
The traffic has gotten worse lately.
my_sentences.ko: 최근에 교통 상황이 더 안 좋아졌어.

my_sentences.en: My English has gotten better lately.
The weather has gotten colder lately.
It has gotten better.
Have you tried + -ing?

my_sentences.ko: → 문제를 해결하기 위해 “~하는 방법을 시도해봤어?”라고 물을 때 아주 자연스러워.

my_sentences.en: Have you tried restarting your computer?
Have you tried using a different charger?
Have you tried calling them?
Have you tried turning it off and on?
You mean + -ing?

my_sentences.ko: → 상대방의 말을 다시 확인할 때 굉장히 유용해.

my_sentences.en: You mean calling them again?
You mean restarting the computer?
You mean using a different password?
You mean going there by myself?
Sometimes it works. Sometimes it doesn’t.
my_sentences.ko: 될 때도 있고 안 될 때도 있어.

my_sentences.en: This method works.
It worked for me.
Sometimes it works, sometimes it doesn't.
my_sentences.ko: 될 때도 있고 안 될 때도 있어.

my_sentences.en: That doesn't work for me.

my_sentences.ko: It’s time for you to + 동사 : 네가 ~할 때가 됐어

my_sentences.en: It’s time for you to go home.
It’s time for us to leave.
Maybe it’s time for you to get a new car.
my_sentences.ko: 이제 너도 새 차를 살 때가 된 것 같아.

my_sentences.en: I think it’s time for me to move on.
my_sentences.ko: 이제 나도 앞으로 나아갈 때가 된 것 같아.
